verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh screens customers against Adverse Media alongside sanctions, PEP and watchlists, and its case management lets analysts review risk alerts and risks in the web app or via API, then record case decisions. That covers the core review of adverse-media matches. However, nothing in the pack shows how matches present their underlying evidence (e.g. linked source articles) or classify adverse media into risk categories. Missing for 10: documentation of linked source evidence/articles on adverse-media hits, adverse-media risk categorization/taxonomy, hands-on or independent corroboration of the review experience.
